edits.original: an unprecedented surge in digital connectivity
edits.reason: "Unprecedented" is an intensifier standing in for a growth figure that the sentence never supplies, so the number must come from the author.

edits.original: This reliance brings extraordinary benefits—speed, efficiency, and the democratization of knowledge
edits.reason: "Extraordinary" pads a list of benefits with no measurement behind it; the evidence has to be supplied rather than invented here.

edits.original: The stakes are high: a single breach can compromise personal identities
edits.reason: "The stakes are high" asserts magnitude without the cost or incident figure that would actually support it.

edits.original: Cyber threats have multiplied both in number and sophistication.
edits.reason: "Multiplied" implies a growth factor that is never given, so the real count or rate needs to come from the author.

edits.original: The café POS vendor still ships terminals with a default password.
edits.reason: This isolated concrete example carries no figure showing why it matters (units shipped, breaches traced to it), so it needs author evidence rather than a rewrite.

edits.original: creating “attack surfaces” that are dramatically broader than in the past
edits.reason: "Dramatically" is pure intensifier padding with no device-count comparison available to substitute, so the word is removed under the no-intensifiers rule.

edits.original: a simple yet often neglected step that accounts for a large proportion of exploit success (Microsoft, 2022)
edits.reason: "A large proportion" is a placeholder for the percentage the cited source should provide, and that figure could not be recovered.

edits.original: Access checks default to fail-closed, rather than open. Fail-closed is the only acceptable default for those checks, end of story.
edits.replacement: Access checks default to fail-closed, rather than open. Fail-closed is the only acceptable default for those checks.
edits.reason: The exclusivity marker "only" already does the emphatic work, so the finality interjection "end of story" repeats it without adding evidence.

edits.original: The playbook change significantly reduces mean time to contain.
edits.replacement: The playbook change cut mean time to contain from 18 hours to 3 hours.
edits.reason: "Significantly" is replaced by the exact figures already present in the preceding sentence, which are the evidence it was standing in for.

edits.original: Those privilege limits are imposed on purpose, rather than by accident.
edits.reason: "On purpose" intensifies intent while naming who decided and when, the evidence that would make the claim verifiable, is missing.

edits.original: Positive reinforcement for reporters is now a standing practice, full stop.
edits.replacement: Positive reinforcement for reporters is now a standing practice.
edits.reason: "Standing" already marks the practice as permanent, so the finality interjection "full stop" only repeats that emphasis.
"Unprecedented" stands in for a count of new information-sharing agreements or CERT partnerships that the passage never provides.

edits.original: Integrating these emerging tools wisely will be pivotal
edits.reason: "Pivotal" claims decisive importance without the metric (breaches prevented, time saved) that would substantiate it.

edits.original: they also open fresh attack vectors that must be managed prudently
edits.reason: "Prudently" substitutes judgment for the concrete control or threshold the sentence should name.
